# Motion and pose files onto a model: swing600.vmd and pose.vpd on chain8.pmx,
# a second model, model selection, and the saves.
load model chain8.pmx
load vmd swing600.vmd
save pmm vmd-loaded.pmm
frame 0
load vpd pose.vpd
select bone センター
register bone
select bone 首
register bone
select bone 髪3
register bone
save pmm vpd-loaded.pmm
load model morph4.pmx
select model chain8
frame 150
select bone 頭
bone rotation 0 0 15
register bone
select all bone
save vmd chain8.vmd
save pmm motion.pmm
